cases.name: Deborah Sue "Debbie" Williamson
cases.about: She was a newlywed of only 10 weeks when she was murdered. Her husband Doug recalled that Debbie was outgoing, personable and hard-working.
cases.narrative:
On 8/24/1975, her husband discovered her body outside their home when he returned from work. Debbie had been stabbed multiple times: 10 to her back, two to her scalp, one to her right cheek, and four to her torso and upper arms. There were abrasions and bruises on her chin, knees, forearms and elbows. Her right ear was nearly severed in the attack.

According to her autopsy report, stab wounds to her back punctured and collapsed both of her lungs. In addition, Debbie’s lungs filled with blood, which quickly rendered her unable to breathe. Two liters of blood were removed from her lungs during the autopsy examination.

Williamson’s pants and underwear had been pulled down to her calves, and her shirt and bra were pushed up. However, the autopsy showed no evidence of sexual assault, and additional forensic testing revealed no indication of rape. It was determined that the action of removing her clothing was completed after her death as there were stab wounds through her garments.

cases.name: Melisa Ann Alvarado Garcia
cases.about: Please send information about her life, dreams or interests to shecounted@gmail.com
cases.narrative:
He led police to the body saying he spotted her body in some tall weeds off a highway while making a U-turn. But he knew details about the scene he could have only known because he was the murderer. 

He approached her while she was making a call from a public telephone outside a convenience store, asked her for a light for his cigarette, walked around the corner to wait for her to finish her call, and then stabbed her in the shoulder. He then forced her into her own car, drove it away, and repeatedly sexually assaulted her. Garcia remained in a semi-conscious state as she was being raped. After sexually assaulting her, he stabbed her in the heart. The state's pathologist confirmed both of the stab wounds as well as the injuries which were indicative of sexual assault, i.e. traumatized external genitalia, swelling of the vaginal area and various cuts and bruises.
